title: Institute of Health footer
description: A charcoal footer slab: a small wordmark top left, two short link columns starting from 40% across (grey titles, white links, a contact block under the first), round white social buttons top right, a huge grey name that runs the full width near the bottom, and a hairline above a small copyright line. Links fade to 65% on hover.
notes: always dark: it adds the .dark class to itself and uses the theme's dark tokens
the giant name is sized in vw for about 14 characters; longer names need a smaller size via className
